info.title: Anyroute API
info.description: Scope: a documented subset of the public HTTP API that the Anyroute router implements. It covers the model catalog, chat completions, embeddings, key creation and listing, generations, status, health and receipts. Other implemented routes (for example legacy completions, the /v1 aliases, key updates, credits, Stock Token payments, BYOK, teams, wallet sign-in, rankings, provider onboarding and the paymaster) are not described here, and a route's absence from this document does not mean it is absent from the router. Endpoint availability, payment modes and model capabilities are deployment-specific. Errors share the OpenRouter-shaped ApiError body; the 4xx responses each operation can return are declared with the reusable responses in components.responses.

parameters.name: lane
parameters.description: public (default) lists every live model. attested lists only models with at least one endpoint served under attested retention with a fresh attestation right now. unlinkable is not available yet (501).

post.description: Supports standard JSON responses and Server-Sent Events when stream is true. A model must support requested capabilities such as tools or response_format. Auth may use a bearer key, wallet authentication, or the per-call payment flow. A 402 response can contain a quote; follow its payment instructions before retrying the exact request. When the router has x402 enabled, the 402 body is also an x402 v1 payment requirement (x402Version, accepts): sign the exact-scheme USDG authorization and retry with X-PAYMENT; the paid response carries X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE.

200.description: Completion JSON, or SSE events followed by data: [DONE] when stream is true.

X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE.description: Present when an x402 payment was settled for this call: base64 JSON {success, transaction, network, payer}.

schema.description: SSE data events; event data carries JSON chunks.

post.description: Uses a prepaid API key, or no key with the per-call payment flow (HTTP 402, including x402 when enabled). Input may be a string or a non-empty array with at most 2048 items.

200.description: Embedding response with usage and signed receipt.

post.summary: Create a root key or authenticated sub-key
post.description: Without Authorization, creates an independent root key with an empty balance. With an authorized management or admin key, creates a virtual sub-key under that account. The response includes the new secret once; store it securely. Root-key creation does not fund the key. Never send a secret in a query string.

201.description: New key metadata and one-time key secret.

get.summary: List keys for the authenticated account

200.description: Key metadata for the authenticated account.

get.description: Returns summaries for the authenticated account. The response's next value can be passed as before to request an older page.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned in next. Pass it through without parsing; current versions may return a legacy ISO-8601 timestamp.

200.description: Generation summaries and the next page cursor, if any.

get.description: Returns a full record only to the account owner or the authenticated paying wallet. The id is supplied as a query parameter because that is the implemented route; do not put API keys or other credentials in URLs.
Returns published runtime configuration, chain public fields, job state and catalog counts. It is not an uptime guarantee.
Returns { ok: true } when this process responds. It does not establish dependency health or uptime.

200.description: Signed receipt and optional anchor proof.

post.description: One JSON-RPC 2.0 message per request: initialize, ping, tools/list and tools/call (list_models, chat, get_receipt, verify_receipt), plus notifications, which get an empty 202. Replies are JSON, never a stream; there are no sessions. Only the chat tool needs an API key, which it spends like /api/v1/chat/completions. Malformed JSON or a batch gets HTTP 400, a request carrying a foreign Origin header gets 403 and GET gets 405; all three carry a JSON-RPC error body.

200.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 response: a result, or an error object with a JSON-RPC code.

202.description: Notification accepted; the body is empty.

post.summary: Save a routing policy callable as model @route/<slug>
post.description: Owner or admin. No prompt text is stored.

patch.summary: Update or rename a saved route
patch.description: Each config section sent replaces that section; null clears it.

post.summary: Create a short-lived, budget-capped session key for an agent run
post.description: Owner or admin. The secret is returned once. A session cannot exceed its creator's budget, expiry or model allowlist.

get.summary: A session key's own remaining budget and time
Session detail with recent call metadata (never content)
Spend totals, projection, anomaly flag, series, breakdowns and key budgets
List alert rules and recent firings

post.summary: Create an alert rule (threshold, budget_pct or anomaly)
post.description: Owner or admin. Webhooks must be HTTPS to a public address and are delivered at most 3 times per firing.

get.summary: A provider's disclosure profile and the class it is served under right now
get.description: Public. Every value is what the operator documented, with its own source and date; nothing is inferred from traffic. A provider with no recorded profile returns the conservative defaults (retention logs, jurisdiction unknown, legal hold undeclared, training use unknown, declared false). current.class is attested only when retention is declared attested and the provider's TEE attestation is fresh now; current.simulated is true when that attestation is a development report (never accepted in production).

put.summary: Replace a provider's disclosure profile (operator only)
put.description: Requires the operator token in X-Admin-Token or as a bearer token; an API key is not accepted. The profile is replaced as a whole: a claim that is left out reverts to its conservative default. A retention other than logs needs a legal_hold claim, and retention attested needs a provider with a TEE and attestation endpoint.

409.description: provider_not_attestable: retention attested was claimed for a provider with no TEE or attestation endpoint (or a development TEE in production).

get.summary: $ANYR balance, tier, perks, tier ladder and free credits for the wallet behind this key
get.description: Only keys from wallet sign-in have a wallet; any other key gets the same shape with wallet null and a hint. Tiers apply only when the router sets both ANYR_TOKEN_ADDRESS and HOLDER_TIERS (enabled). The balance is read live (cached for 5 minutes); when it cannot be read, balance_error is true and no tier applies. discount_bps lowers Anyroute's own fee rates (the per-call margin and the BYOK fee), never below 0; prepaid calls carry no margin, so for them the discount is 0.

patch.summary: Update an alert rule (kind cannot change; webhook_url null removes it)

BearerAuth.description: Send the key in Authorization. Never put it in a URL.

WalletAuth.name: X-Wallet-Auth
WalletAuth.description: Wallet authentication header for supported per-call flows.

Payment.name: X-Payment
Payment.description: Payment for this exact request: a CallPay transaction hash, or an x402 payment (base64 JSON {x402Version, scheme, network, payload}) from a 402 quote. Do not replay blindly.

PayWith.name: X-Pay-With
PayWith.description: Configured Stock Token symbol for a key with an active session.

DisclosureMax.name: X-Anyroute-Disclosure-Max
DisclosureMax.description: Same as provider.disclosure. When both are given the stricter one applies.

Lane.name: X-Anyroute-Lane
Lane.description: Same as provider.lane. When both are given the stricter one applies. unlinkable is not available yet (501).

Disclosure.description: The disclosure class the answering provider was served under: attested (retention declared attested and a fresh TEE attestation), policy (a documented no-retention policy, no legal hold) or vendor-forwarded (anything else). On a stream it is sent only when every provider the request can reach shares one class; the signed receipt always carries it.

LaneServed.description: The lane the request asked for.

ApiError.description: OpenRouter-shaped API error. A 402 payment response may include payment metadata and is not a signal to repeat payment automatically.

BadRequest.description: The request body, JSON or parameters failed validation. error.type is, for example, invalid_request, invalid_json or invalid_guardrails; do not retry the same request unchanged.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is missing or was rejected: no API key, an unknown, disabled or expired key, or invalid wallet authentication. error.type is missing_key, invalid_key, key_disabled, key_expired or invalid_wallet_auth.

PaymentRequired.description: The call cannot be paid: the balance or the key's budget is insufficient (insufficient_credits, key_budget_exceeded), or a per-call payment is required or was not accepted (payment_required, payment_pending, payment_insufficient, payment_unknown_quote, payment_failed). A payment_required quote is in error.metadata and binds to this exact request; never repeat a payment automatically.

X-Payment-Required.description: Present on a per-call payment quote; names the payment asset.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Present on a per-call payment quote; carries the chain and quote nonce.

Forbidden.description: The key is valid but may not do this: its role does not allow the action, or its model allowlist excludes the model. error.type is forbidden or model_not_allowed.

NotFound.description: The model, provider route, key, team, generation or receipt does not exist or is not visible to the caller. error.type is, for example, not_found, model_not_found or no_providers.

DisclosureUnavailable.description: 409. No provider meets provider.disclosure or provider.lane, though the model has providers that would otherwise serve the request. error.type is disclosure_unavailable or lane_unavailable. The request is never routed to a provider that does not meet the setting; nothing was sent to any provider and nothing was charged.

LaneNotAvailable.description: 501 lane_not_available. Lane unlinkable is not available yet: it needs a blind-token payment and relay path this router does not run. Nothing was sent to any provider.

DisclosureProviderDown.description: 503 disclosure_provider_unavailable. Providers that meet provider.disclosure or provider.lane exist but are all in an outage right now. Retry after Retry-After; the request is not routed to any other provider and nothing was charged.

TooManyRequests.description: A rate limit was reached (rate_limited). Wait for the Retry-After interval before retrying.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when the limit reports it.

pricing.description: Prices are returned as decimal strings per token; consult the live response.

disclosure.description: How many live endpoints are served under each disclosure class right now.

model.description: Public model ID, optionally with a supported routing modifier.

tools.description: Requires a model/provider that supports tools.

response_format.description: Requires a model/provider that supports the requested response format.

ProviderPreferences.description: Provider routing preferences (order, only, ignore, sort, max_price, private and others) plus the disclosure options below.

disclosure.description: Ceiling on how a prompt may be handled. none: only providers whose retention is declared attested and whose TEE attestation is fresh. policy: those, plus providers with a documented no-retention policy and no legal hold. any: no filter. Never silently relaxed: if nothing qualifies the request fails (409, or 503 when qualifying providers are down). A request with a ceiling never uses the response cache.

lane.description: public: no additional filter. attested: same as disclosure none. unlinkable: not available yet (501).

source.description: The document or statement the value comes from.

as_of.description: The date the source was checked.

declared.description: False when the operator has recorded nothing; every value is then the conservative default.

retention.description: attested: the provider states prompts are not retained and runs in a TEE. policy: a documented no-retention policy. logs: prompts may be logged (default).

jurisdiction.description: Where the operator is subject to legal process; unknown by default.

active.description: null = not declared. A no-retention policy is not trusted while a hold is active or undeclared.

claims.description: The source and date behind each value; null when the value is a default.

simulated.description: True when the attestation behind an attested class is a development report.

DisclosureInput.description: Every claim is optional and carries its own source and date.

management.description: Only honored for authorized authenticated sub-key creation; root-key management is never granted by this field.

payload.description: Signed fields. Among them, disclosure (attested, policy or vendor-forwarded) and lane (public or attested) record how the call was served; attestation_simulated is true when the attestation behind an attested call is a development report. Receipts issued before these fields existed do not carry them.

models.description: Catalog model ids in fallback order; no nested @route/.

provider.description: Provider preferences: order, only, ignore, allow_fallbacks, sort (price|latency|throughput), data_collection, zdr, require_parameters, max_price.

params.description: Default request parameters from a closed whitelist (temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, top_a, frequency_penalty, presence_penalty, repetition_penalty, max_tokens, seed, stop, reasoning, verbosity). Prompt fields are rejected.

model.description: Use as the request model, e.g. @route/my-coder.

allowed_models.description: Catalog ids or @route/<slug>; must be within the creator's allowlist.

metadata.description: Labels only, at most 2 KB; prompt-like keys are refused.

SpendReport.description: Spend for the caller's scope (a management key sees its account; other keys see themselves). UTC calendar.

min.description: Minimum balance in whole tokens (decimal string).

rpm_multiplier.description: Multiplies the key's rpm and tpm limits.

discount_bps.description: Lowers Anyroute's own fee rates by this many basis points, never below 0.

enabled.description: Whether holder tiers apply to requests on this router.

wallet.description: The wallet behind this key (wallet sign-in keys only).

balance.description: Token balance in whole tokens (decimal string).

balance_error.description: True when the balance could not be read; no tier applies until it can.

rpm.description: This key's request limit per minute with the multiplier (0 = unlimited).

credits_received.description: Free inference credits paid to this wallet, newest first. They pay for inference only and are not withdrawable.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS, public address only; stored encrypted.
